title: Combining Exponential and Polynomial Convergence Rates for Accelerated Extremum Seeking: A High-Order Lie Bracket Approach
summary: In this paper, we leverage the recently developed general higher-order Lie bracket approximation theory and framework for control-affine systems to show that we can design extremum seeking (ES) systems that combine flows based on: (i) first-order Lie bracket approximation, which provide an exponential convergence rate for quadratic objective functions and polynomial convergence rate for non-quadratic objective functions; and (ii) higher-order Lie bracket approximation, which provide exponential convergence rate near the minimizer even if the objective function is non-quadratic (i.e., flatter…
